title: Apple guides March-quarter gross margin above 46%
html:
Proposition

Apple guides March-quarter gross margin above 46%

At its January 28, 2027 report Apple guides March-quarter gross margin with a midpoint above 46.0%: price increases and Services mix outrun memory costs.

When
The decision on Jan 28, 2027
Known from
Apple fiscal Q1 2027 earnings call and release
Forecast20.0%
0%100%

How it’s set

Rationale

A rebound above the December-quarter range needs memory costs to stop rising within one quarter, against management's own warning. Possible through mix and the $100 iPhone price rise, but the least likely of the three: one in five.
